nodes.title: Banking and Insurance Business Provisions
nodes.summary: Amendments related to expense deductions and loss carry-forward for banking and general insurance businesses.

children.title: Banking Business: Risk-Bearing Fund Deduction (Sub-section 1क)
children.summary: Allows up to 5% of unrecovered loans in risk-bearing fund as deductible expense; amended by Economic Ordinance 2059.

children.title: Banking Business: Loss Deduction (Sub-section 2)
children.summary: Permits deducting banking business losses from past five income years' income; amended by Economic Act 2064.

children.title: Banking Business: Loss Deduction Conditions (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Specifies conditions for deducting banking business losses, including limits and definition of 'banking business'.

children.title: General Insurance Business: Loss Deduction (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Allows deducting general insurance business losses from past five income years' income; amended by Economic Act 2064.

children.title: General Insurance Business: Loss Deduction Conditions (Sub-section 4)
children.summary: Outlines conditions for deducting general insurance business losses; amended by Economic Act 2064.

nodes.title: Retirement Funds and Related Provisions
nodes.summary: Amendments concerning retirement fund approval, exemptions, expenses, income, and related definitions.

children.title: Retirement Fund Approval Process (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provisions requiring application and approval for establishing retirement funds; amended by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Exemptions from Retirement Fund Approval (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of exemptions for Citizen Investment Trust, Social Security Fund, Employees Provident Fund, Pension Fund; amended by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Inclusion of Government Retirement Payments
children.summary: Addition of 'payment from Nepal Government' to retirement payments; amended by Economic Ordinance 2059.

children.title: Clarification of Contribution-Based Interest (Dafa 63, Sub-section 3) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of clarification for 'contribution-based interest' related to retirement contributions; amended by Economic Act 2081.

children.title: Repeal of Dafa 66: Retirement Fund Expenses and Income
children.summary: Repeal of section detailing expenses (contributions) and income (asset returns) related to interest in retirement funds; repealed by Economic Ordinance 2060.

nodes.title: Tax Administration and Definitions
nodes.summary: Amendments to taxpayer duties, definitions of tax terms, and names of tax offices.

children.title: Definition of 'Liability in Nepal'
children.summary: Amendment to the definition of 'liability to be borne in Nepal'; amended by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Definition of 'Average Tax Rate of Nepal'
children.summary: Amendment to the definition of 'average tax rate of Nepal' for foreign tax credit calculation; amended by Economic Ordinance 2060.

children.title: Changes in Tax Office Names
children.summary: Amendments to include 'Large Taxpayer Office', 'Taxpayer Service Office', 'Medium Level Taxpayer Office'; amended by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: Taxpayer Rights and Duties (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Amendment stating taxpayers cannot enjoy rights without fulfilling duties; amended by Economic Ordinance 2059.

children.title: Permanent Account Number (PAN) Issuance (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Amendment regarding PAN issuance by Department and approved entities, with import/export restrictions; amended by Economic Act 2063.

nodes.title: Record Keeping and Electronic Records
nodes.summary: Provision for the Department to approve electronic record-keeping for taxpayers.

children.title: Electronic Record Keeping Approval (Sub-section 4)
children.summary: Department can approve taxpayers to keep required documents electronically; added by Economic Act 2064.

nodes.title: Tax Deduction at Source (TDS)
nodes.summary: Comprehensive amendments to TDS rates, scope, and exemptions for various income types and payments.

children.title: TDS on Resident Payments (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Initial 15% TDS on Nepal-sourced interest, natural resources, rent, royalty, service fees, retirement payments by residents.

children.title: Original 15% Rate and Retirement Fund Proviso
children.summary: 15% TDS on various resident payments; 6% on approved retirement fund/gratuity profit; amended by Economic Act 2075.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: 6% TDS on government/approved retirement fund profit; 5% on non-resident commission; 10% on aircraft lease.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: 1.5% TDS on VAT-registered resident service provider fees.

children.title: Economic Act 2065 Revisions
children.summary: 10% TDS on Nepal-sourced rent paid by residents.

children.title: Economic Act 2066 Revisions
children.summary: 10% TDS on profits/gains from commodity future market transactions.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions
children.summary: 5% on government/approved retirement fund profit; 5% on non-resident commission; 10% on aircraft lease; 1.5% on VAT-registered service fees; 10% on Nepal-sourced rent; 5% on mutual fund distributions.

children.title: Economic Act 2072 Revisions
children.summary: 1.5% TDS on vehicle rental payments to VAT-registered businesses.

children.title: Economic Act 2075 Revisions
children.summary: 2.5% TDS on transport service/vehicle rental payments.

children.title: Economic Act 2077 Revisions
children.summary: 2.5% TDS on transport service/vehicle rental; 1.5% for VAT-registered providers.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2078 Repeal
children.summary: Repeal of 1.5% TDS for VAT-registered transport services, reverting to 2.5%.

children.title: TDS on Dividends, Insurance Gains, Unapproved Retirement Funds (Sub-section 2)
children.summary: Amendments to TDS rates for resident individuals on Nepal-sourced dividends, investment insurance gains, and unapproved retirement fund gains.

children.title: Original 10% Rate
children.summary: 10% TDS on dividends, investment insurance gains, unapproved retirement fund gains; amended by Economic Act 2066.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: 5% on dividends, 5% on investment insurance gains, 10% on unapproved retirement fund gains.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: Dividends: 5% (resident), 10% (non-resident); Investment insurance/personal accident compensation: 5%; Unapproved retirement fund gain: 5%.

children.title: TDS on Interest from Banks/FIs (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Amendments to 6% TDS on interest paid by resident banks/FIs to natural persons, expanding scope.

children.title: Original 6% Rate for Banks/FIs
children.summary: 6% TDS on interest from resident banks/FIs to natural persons for Nepal-sourced, non-business income.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Scope Expansion
children.summary: Expanded 6% TDS to include interest from other debt-issuing entities and registered companies on deposits, debentures, government bonds.

children.title: TDS on Service Fees and Professional Payments
children.summary: Amendments to TDS on service fees to companies and payments for professional/academic work.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2061 Additions
children.summary: Added TDS on service fees to companies and payments for question paper preparation/answer sheet checking.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2062 Revisions
children.summary: Revised TDS to apply to service fees to *resident* companies and payments for articles in periodicals.

children.title: TDS Exemptions (Repealed/Revised)
children.summary: Changes to exemptions from TDS for various payments, including hydropower interest, government payments, and mutual funds.

children.title: Hydropower Interest Exemption (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of exemption for interest on foreign currency loans by large hydropower projects; repealed by Economic Act 2080.

children.title: Government Payments to Foreign Entities
children.summary: Exemption for interest/fees paid by Nepal Government to foreign governments/international organizations under agreement; added by Economic Act 2064.

children.title: Rural Financial Institutions/Cooperatives Interest Exemption (Repealed)
children.summary: Exemption for annual interest up to NPR 10,000 from deposits in rural microfinance, rural development banks, postal savings banks, and cooperatives; repealed by Economic Act 2071.

children.title: Mutual Fund Payments Exemption (Repealed)
children.summary: Exemption for dividends and interest paid to mutual funds; repealed by Economic Ordinance 2078.

children.title: TDS on General Insurance and Contracts (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Amendments to TDS on general insurance premiums or contract payments exceeding NPR 50,000.

children.title: Original 1.5% Rate
children.summary: 1.5% TDS on general insurance premium or contract payments over NPR 50,000; amended by Economic Act 2065.

children.title: TDS on Contracts with Non-Residents (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Amendments to TDS rates for payments by residents to non-residents under contracts.

children.title: Economic Act 2065 Revisions
children.summary: 10% for service contracts, 5% for other contracts, 1.5% for non-resident insurance premium.

children.title: Economic Act 2067 Revisions
children.summary: 5% for aircraft lease and other contracts, 1.5% for non-resident insurance premium.

children.title: TDS Exemption for Security Forces Purchases (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of exemption for payments by Nepal Army, Police, Armed Police Force for arms, ammunition, communication equipment; repealed by Economic Act 2080.

children.title: TDS on Contract Payments: Exemptions (Sub-section 4)
children.summary: Amendments to payments exempt from TDS on contracts, particularly for natural persons.

children.title: Original Exemptions
children.summary: Exempted payments by natural persons not related to business, or tax-exempt payments; amended by Economic Act 2075.

children.title: Economic Act 2070 Revisions
children.summary: Exempted payments to non-business natural persons, except Nepal-sourced rent for land/house/equipment.

children.title: TDS on Capital Gains from Resident Entities (Dafa 89क) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of TDS on gains from disposal of interest in resident entities, with rates of 10% for resident natural persons and 15% for others; repealed by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: TDS on Capital Gains from House/Land (Dafa 89ख) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of TDS on capital gains from disposal of house/land by natural persons, with rates of 5% (>5 years ownership) and 10% (<5 years ownership); repealed by Economic Act 2067.

nodes.title: Tax Payment and Advance Tax
nodes.summary: Amendments to TDS statement filing, installment tax, advance tax collection, and related liabilities.

children.title: TDS Statement Filing (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Amendments to requirements and deadlines for filing TDS statements by tax deductors.

children.title: Original Filing Requirements
children.summary: Detailed requirements for TDS statements, including payee info and tax deducted, within 15 days of month-end.

children.title: Economic Act 2063 Revisions
children.summary: Simplified filing requirement: within 15 days of month-end in prescribed format.

children.title: Tax Payment on Non-Business House Rent (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provision for tax on non-business house rent income to be paid by Ashar end; repealed by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: TDS: Joint and Several Liability (Sub-section 5)
children.summary: Establishes joint and several liability for tax deductor and payee if tax is not deducted or deposited; amended by Economic Ordinance 2060.

children.title: TDS Exemptions: Investment Gains and Professional Fees
children.summary: Amendments to exemptions from TDS for investment gains, personal accident compensation, bank interest, and professional fees.

children.title: Investment Gains and Accident Compensation
children.summary: Evolution of definition for 'gain paid by resident person for investment' to include personal accident compensation and investment insurance.

children.title: Bank/FI Interest Exemption
children.summary: Exemption for interest paid by bank/financial institution as per Dafa 88(3); amended by Economic Ordinance 2059.

children.title: Professional/Meeting Fees Exemption
children.summary: Exemption for meeting allowance, occasional teaching, and previously, exam-related payments; amended by Economic Ordinance 2060.

children.title: Transport/Vehicle Rental Exemption (Natural Persons)
children.summary: Exemption for payments for vehicle/transport rental or service by natural persons (excluding sole proprietorships); amended by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Tax Payment in Installments (Dafa 94)
children.summary: Amendments to the schedule and components of tax payment in installments.

children.title: Original Installment Schedule
children.summary: Three installments: 40% by Poush end, 70% by Chait end, 100% by Ashadh end; amended by Economic Ordinance 2060.

children.title: Components of 'Tax Already Paid'
children.summary: Includes TDS from payments under Section 17, deemed TDS under Dafa 90(3), and tax credit for approved medical expenses under Dafa 51.

children.title: Advance Tax Collection (Dafa 95क)
children.summary: Amendments to advance tax collection, particularly for capital gains on land/buildings.

children.title: Deposit Requirements (Sub-section 6)
children.summary: Deposit of advance tax collected or deemed collected; amended by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Advance Tax on Land/Building Gains (Sub-section 6)
children.summary: 10% advance tax collected by Land Revenue Office on gains from disposal of land/building; amended by Economic Act 2073.

children.title: Advance Tax on Capital Gains (Natural Persons) Rate Change
children.summary: Amendment to the 5% rate for resident natural persons' capital gains; amended by Economic Ordinance 2078.

children.title: Advance Tax on Capital Gains (Others) Rate Change
children.summary: Amendment to the 10% rate for others' capital gains; amended by Economic Act 2075.

children.title: Advance Tax on Land/Private Building Gains (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Original rates: 2.5% if ownership > 5 years, 5% if ownership < 5 years; amended by Economic Act 2073.

children.title: Deemed Collection of Advance Tax (Sub-section 4) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provision for deemed collection of advance tax even if not actually collected; repealed by Economic Ordinance 2078.

children.title: Advance Tax Exemption for Mutual Fund Investments (Sub-section 4)
children.summary: No advance tax on disposal of interest invested by mutual funds; amended by Economic Act 2073.

children.title: Advance Tax on Land/Building Gains (Sub-section 6) Rate Change
children.summary: Amendment to the 10% rate for land/building gains by Land Revenue Office; amended by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Advance Tax on Software/Electronic Services Export (Sub-section 6ख)
children.summary: 1% advance tax on foreign currency payments received for software/electronic services provided outside Nepal, collected by banks/FIs/money transfer agents; added by Economic Ordinance 2078.

children.title: Advance Tax on Imports at Customs Point (Sub-section 7) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of advance income tax collection at customs point for commercial imports, with detailed rates for various goods categories; repealed by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Economic Act 2081 Rates (Repealed)
children.summary: 10% for live animals, meat, fish, flowers, edible plants, fruits; 2.5% for dairy, eggs, honey, grains, flour, herbs, sugarcane, plant products; 1.5% for VAT-taxable imports.

children.title: Economic Act 2075 Rates (Repealed)
children.summary: 5% for specific live animals, fish, fresh flowers, vegetables, fruits; 2.5% for meat, dairy, eggs, honey, grains, flour, herbs, sugarcane, plant products; 1.5% for VAT-taxable imports.

children.title: Advance Tax: Deemed Collection (Sub-section 8)
children.summary: Amendment to the provision for deemed collection of advance tax even if not actually collected; amended by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Advance Tax: Credit Against Annual Liability (Sub-section 10)
children.summary: Original provision allowing advance tax filed to be reduced from annual tax liability; amended by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: Advance Tax: Joint and Several Liability (Sub-section 10)
children.summary: Establishes joint and several liability for advance tax deductor and payee if tax is not collected or deposited; amended by Economic Act 2073.

children.title: Advance Tax: Deposit Requirements (Sub-section 10)
children.summary: Requires deposit of advance tax collected or deemed collected, referencing other sub-sections; amended by Economic Act 2075.

nodes.title: Income Statement and Tax Credit
nodes.summary: Amendments to tax credit provisions, income statement filing requirements, and exemptions.

children.title: Tax Credit Provisions (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provisions for tax credit for TDS, installment payments, or assessed tax; repealed by Economic Ordinance 2060.

children.title: Income Statement Filing Requirements (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of requirements for TDS certificate and proof of election under Dafa 4(4) when filing income statement; repealed by Economic Ordinance 2060/2078.

children.title: Income Statement Filing Exemptions (Dafa 97)
children.summary: Amendments to categories of persons exempt from filing income statements, and conditions for mandatory filing.

children.title: Original Exemptions
children.summary: Exemptions for non-taxable persons, Dafa 3(ग) persons, and Dafa 4(3) resident natural persons; amended by Economic Act 2072.

children.title: Economic Act 2072 Revisions
children.summary: Revised exemptions, including vehicle owners under Schedule-1, Dafa 1(13); mandatory filing for natural persons with income > NPR 4 million.

children.title: Income Inclusion/Exclusion for Filing Threshold
children.summary: Specifies income types to be included (business exemption facilities) and excluded (meeting allowance, interest) for the NPR 4 million threshold.

children.title: Deductions from Calculated Income
children.summary: Allows deductions for Dafa 3(ग) income and Dafa 11 tax-exempt income, excluding meeting allowance and interest income.

children.title: Income Statement Format
children.summary: Format of income statement for mandatory filers to be prescribed by Inland Revenue Department.

children.title: Economic Act 2075 Revisions
children.summary: Amended 'vehicle owner' to 'vehicle owner excluding sole proprietorship' and added clause (ङ).

nodes.title: Tax Appeals and Penalties
nodes.summary: Amendments to outstanding tax collection, advance tax carry-forward, appeal deposit requirements, deemed rejection, and various penalties.

children.title: Outstanding Tax Collection in Installments (Dafa 110क)
children.summary: Tax officer can approve installment payment for outstanding tax if requested before legal action; amended by Economic Act 2063.

children.title: Advance Tax Carry Forward/Refund (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provision that advance tax collected under Dafa 95क(7) cannot be carried forward or refunded; repealed by Economic Act 2082.

children.title: Appeals: Tax Deposit Requirements (Sub-section 6)
children.summary: Evolution of tax deposit requirements for appeals against decisions.

children.title: Original 50% Deposit
children.summary: Requires deposit of 50% of tax payable for a provision to apply; amended by Economic Act 2073.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Requires deposit of 50% of remaining tax when appealing a Dafa 114(1)(ङ) decision.

children.title: Economic Act 2063/2064 Revisions
children.summary: Deposit 1/3 of tax, then full undisputed tax plus 1/3 of disputed tax.

children.title: Appeals: Deemed Rejection (Sub-section 8)
children.summary: Amendments to timelines for deemed rejection of appeal if Department fails to notify decision.

children.title: Original 90-Day Period
children.summary: Appeal deemed rejected if Department doesn't notify decision within 90 days; amended by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2061 Revisions
children.summary: Reduced period to 60 days for deemed rejection of appeal.

children.title: Appeals: Notification of Deemed Rejection (Sub-section 9)
children.summary: Applicant must inform Department of deemed rejection, which then deems rejection and notification on that date; amended by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Penalties for Non-Filing of Income Statement (Sub-section 1)
children.summary: Evolution of penalties for not filing income statements under Dafa 95(1) or 96(1).

children.title: Original Penalty
children.summary: 1.5% p.a. of assessable income or NPR 1,000/month, whichever is higher; amended by Economic Act 2075.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: 0.1% p.a. of assessable income or NPR 1,000/year, whichever is higher.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: NPR 2,000 for Dafa 95(1); for Dafa 96(1): NPR 100/month (Dafa 4(4) persons) or 0.1% p.a. of assessable income/NPR 100/month (others).

children.title: Economic Act 2067 Revisions
children.summary: Added 1.5% p.a. penalty for not filing Dafa 95क(5) advance tax collection statement.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions
children.summary: Added 0.1% p.a. penalty for tax-exempt entities not filing financial statements on time.

children.title: Penalties for Non-Keeping Records (Sub-section 2)
children.summary: Penalty for not keeping records as per Dafa 81: 1.5% p.a. of assessable income or NPR 1,000/month, whichever is higher; amended by Economic Act 2066.

children.title: Penalties for Non-Filing TDS Statement (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Penalty for not filing TDS statement under Dafa 90(1): 1.5% p.a. of TDS amount for each month/part thereof; amended by Economic Act 2075.

children.title: Interest for Underpayment of Installment Tax (Dafa 118)
children.summary: Amendments to calculation and rates of interest for underpayment of estimated tax in installments.

children.title: Original Interest Calculation
children.summary: Interest on shortfall if installment tax paid is less than 90% of tax payable; amended by Economic Ordinance 2062.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Interest on excess of 80% of estimated/actual tax over tax paid for each installment, at normal interest rate.

children.title: Economic Act 2067 Revisions
children.summary: Changed estimated tax calculation from 80% to 90%; amended by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: Interest: Deductor's Non-Recovery from Payee (Sub-section 3)
children.summary: Tax deductor cannot recover interest from payee if non-compliance with Dafa 90(4) caused the interest; amended by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: General Penalties for Non-Compliance (Dafa 119क)
children.summary: General penalty for non-compliance with Act/Rules: NPR 5,000 to NPR 25,000; amended by Economic Act 2081.

children.title: Rewards and Informant Expenses (Dafa 136क)
children.summary: Provisions for rewards and informant expenses for providing information on tax evasion, including confidentiality.

children.title: Original Penalty Exemption (Repealed)
children.summary: Exemption from penalty if tax burden changes due to interpretation but collection amount doesn't; repealed by Economic Act 2064.

children.title: Economic Act 2064: Reward for Tax Evasion Info
children.summary: 20% reward of recovered tax based on evidence for providing information on tax evasion.

children.title: Economic Act 2071: Reward and Informant Expenses
children.summary: 20% reward for tax evasion info; immediate informant expense up to NPR 10,000 for revenue leakage info; informant's identity kept confidential.

nodes.title: Schedule-1: Income Tax Rates and Related Provisions
nodes.summary: Extensive amendments to income tax rates for natural persons, couples, capital gains, presumptive tax, and various entities.

children.title: Tax on Royal Family Income (Dafa 141क) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of provision for tax on income of King, Queen, Crown Prince, and Royal Family members; repealed by Ganatantra Sudridhikaran Ain 2066.

children.title: Resident Natural Persons: Tiered Income Tax Rates (Dafa 1(1))
children.summary: Evolution of tiered income tax rates and thresholds for resident natural persons.

children.title: Original Rates (2079 Amendment Context)
children.summary: 0% up to NPR 55k; 15% on excess up to NPR 130k; NPR 11,250 + 25% on excess above NPR 130k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 65k, 85k, 140k, 160k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 80k, 100k, 155k, 175k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2062 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 100k, 125k, 175k, 200k.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: 0% up to NPR 115k; 15% on excess up to NPR 200k; NPR 12,750 + 25% on excess above NPR 200k.

children.title: Economic Act 2066 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 160k (not for sole proprietorships); NPR 1,600 + 15% on excess up to NPR 260k; NPR 16,600 + 25% on excess above NPR 260k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2067 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 160k; NPR 1,600 + 15% on excess up to NPR 260k; NPR 16,600 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2070 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 200k; NPR 2,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 300k; NPR 17,000 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 250k; NPR 2,500 + 15% on excess up to NPR 350k; NPR 17,500 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2073 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 350k (not for sole proprietorships/pension); NPR 3,500 + 15% on excess up to NPR 450k; NPR 18,500 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2076 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 400k (not for sole proprietorships/pension/social security); NPR 4,000 + 10% on excess up to NPR 500k; NPR 14,000 + 20% on excess up to NPR 700k; NPR 54,000 + 30% on excess up to NPR 2M; 20% additional tax above NPR 2M.

children.title: Resident Married Couples: Tiered Income Tax Rates (Dafa 1(2))
children.summary: Evolution of tiered income tax rates and thresholds for resident married couples electing joint assessment.

children.title: Original Rates (2076 Amendment Context)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 75k; 15% on excess up to NPR 150k; NPR 11,250 + 25% on excess above NPR 150k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 85k, 160k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 100k, 155k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2061 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 100k, 175k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2062 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 125k, 200k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2064 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NPR 140k, 225k; base tax NPR 12,750.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2066 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 200k (not for sole proprietorships); NPR 2,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 300k; NPR 17,000 + 25% on excess above NPR 300k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2067 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 200k; NPR 2,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 300k; NPR 17,000 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2070 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 250k; NPR 2,500 + 15% on excess up to NPR 350k; NPR 17,500 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 300k; NPR 3,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 400k; NPR 18,000 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2073 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 400k (not for sole proprietorships/pension); NPR 4,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 500k; NPR 19,000 + 25% on excess up to NPR 2.5M; 40% additional tax above NPR 2.5M.

children.title: Economic Act 2075 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 400k (not for sole proprietorships/pension/social security); NPR 4,000 + 15% on excess up to NPR 500k; NPR 19,000 + 20% on excess up to NPR 700k; NPR 59,000 + 30% on excess up to NPR 2M; 20% additional tax above NPR 2M.

children.title: Economic Act 2076 Revisions (Employment Income)
children.summary: 1% up to NPR 450k (not for sole proprietorships/pension/social security); NPR 4,500 + 10% on excess up to NPR 550k; NPR 14,500 + 20% on excess up to NPR 750k; NPR 54,500 + 30% on excess up to NPR 2M; 20% additional tax above NPR 2M.

children.title: Capital Gains Tax Application Conditions (Dafa 1(3))
children.summary: Evolution of income thresholds for resident natural persons and couples for capital gains tax application.

children.title: Original Conditions (2079 Amendment Context)
children.summary: NP income > NPR 55k, or couple income > NPR 75k; capital gains from non-business taxable assets included.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 65k, couple > NPR 85k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 80k, couple > NPR 100k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2062 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 100k, couple > NPR 125k.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 115k, couple > NPR 140k.

children.title: Economic Act 2066 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 160k, couple > NPR 200k.

children.title: Economic Act 2070 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 200k, couple > NPR 250k.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 250k, couple > NPR 300k.

children.title: Economic Act 2073 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 350k, couple > NPR 400k.

children.title: Economic Act 2076 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP > NPR 400k, couple > NPR 450k; capital gains from non-business taxable assets included.

children.title: Capital Gains Tax Calculation (Dafa 1(4))
children.summary: Evolution of capital gains tax calculation methods, thresholds, and specific rates for land/house and listed entity interests.

children.title: Original Calculation (2079 Amendment Context)
children.summary: Tax on higher of (total income - capital gain) or threshold (NP NPR 55k, couple NPR 75k); remaining capital gain at 10%.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2059 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 65k, couple NPR 85k; original proviso repealed.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 80k, couple NPR 100k.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2062 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 100k, couple NPR 125k.

children.title: Economic Act 2064 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 115k, couple NPR 140k.

children.title: Economic Act 2066 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 160k, couple NPR 200k; 5% for land/house ownership > 5 years, 10% for < 5 years.

children.title: Economic Act 2068 Additions
children.summary: Added 5% tax on gains from disposal of interest in Nepal Stock Exchange listed entities.

children.title: Economic Act 2070 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 200k, couple NPR 250k.

children.title: Economic Act 2071 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 250k, couple NPR 300k.

children.title: Economic Act 2073 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 350k, couple NPR 400k.

children.title: Economic Act 2075 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 350k, couple NPR 400k; land/house disposal: 2.5% (>5 years), 5% (<5 years); listed entity interest: 5%.

children.title: Economic Act 2078 Revisions
children.summary: Thresholds revised to NP NPR 400k, couple NPR 450k; listed entity interest: 5% (>365 days), 7.5% (<=365 days).

children.title: Remote Area Tax Exemption/Deduction (Dafa 1(5))
children.summary: Evolution of tax benefits for natural persons residing in remote areas.

children.title: Original Exemption
children.summary: Up to NPR 30,000 increase in tax-free threshold (NPR 55k/75k); amended by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: Economic Ordinance 2060 Revisions
children.summary: Up to NPR 30,000 deduction from taxable income for remote area allowance.

children.title: Presumptive Tax Rates (Dafa 1(7))
children.summary: Evolution of presumptive tax rates based on geographical area for small businesses.

children.title: Original Rates
children.summary: NPR 2,000 (Metropolitan/Sub-Metropolitan), NPR 1,500 (Municipality), NPR 1,000 (Other areas); amended by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Economic Act 2065 Revisions
children.summary: NPR 5,000 (Metropolitan/Sub-Metropolitan), NPR 2,500 (Municipality), NPR 1,500 (Other areas).

children.title: Pension Income Deduction (Dafa 1(9)) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of additional 25% deduction from taxable income for pension income of resident natural persons/couples; repealed by Economic Act 2077.

children.title: Investment Insurance Premium Deduction (Dafa 1(10))
children.summary: Amendments to the deduction limit for investment insurance premiums.

children.title: Original Deduction Limit
children.summary: Lower of 7% of insured amount or NPR 10,000; amended by Economic Act 2065.

children.title: Economic Act 2075/2079 Revisions
children.summary: Deduction limit amended to NPR 20,000, then NPR 25,000.

children.title: Annual Tax on Rental Vehicles (Dafa 1(13))
children.summary: Evolution of annual tax rates on rental vehicle owners, collected by Transport Management Office.

children.title: Economic Act 2079 Notification Rates
children.summary: Rates from NPR 1,500 (Power Tiller) to NPR 12,000 (Excavator, Oil Tanker) based on vehicle type and engine capacity.

children.title: Economic Act 2072 Revisions
children.summary: Rates from NPR 1,000 (Tractor/Power Tiller) to NPR 3,000 (Minibus/Truck); final tax for natural person owners.

children.title: Original Rates (Before 2072)
children.summary: Rates from NPR 750 (Tractor/Power Tiller) to NPR 1,500 (Minibus/Truck); final tax for natural person owners.

children.title: Reduced Tax for Special Industries (Dafa 1(14)) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of reduced tax rate (20% instead of 25%) for natural persons in special industries under Dafa 11; repealed by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Reduced Tax for Export Income (Dafa 1(15)) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of reduced tax rate (15% instead of 25%) for natural persons on export income; repealed by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Turnover Tax Rates (Dafa 1(17))
children.summary: Evolution of turnover tax rates for different business types and turnover thresholds.

children.title: Economic Act 2072 Rates
children.summary: 0.5% (gas/cigarette), 1.5% (other goods), 2% (services); minimum NPR 5,000 tax.

children.title: Economic Act 2076 Revisions
children.summary: For turnover > NPR 2M: 0.25% (gas/cigarette), 0.75% (other goods), 2% (services).

children.title: Cooperative Tax Rates (Dafa 2(3))
children.summary: Evolution of tax rates for cooperatives registered under Cooperative Act 2074, for non-exempt transactions, based on geographical area.

children.title: Economic Act 2079 Notification Rates
children.summary: 5% (Municipality), 7% (Sub-Metropolitan), 10% (Metropolitan).

children.title: Economic Act 2079 Rates
children.summary: 7.5% (Municipality), 10% (Sub-Metropolitan), 15% (Metropolitan).

children.title: Economic Act 2077 Revisions
children.summary: 5% (Municipality), 7% (Sub-Metropolitan), 10% (Metropolitan).

children.title: Economic Act 2079 Final Revisions
children.summary: 7.5% (Municipality), 10% (Sub-Metropolitan), 15% (Metropolitan).

children.title: Entity Tax Rates: Special Industries and Infrastructure (Dafa 2(3))
children.summary: Amendments to 20% tax rate for entities in special industries, infrastructure, and transport.

children.title: Original Scope
children.summary: 20% tax for entities in Dafa 11 special industries, or constructing/operating roads, bridges, tunnels, ropeways, flyovers, or trolley buses/trams.

children.title: Economic Act 2067: Ropeway Clarification
children.summary: Clarification that 'ropeway' includes cable cars for goods or passenger transport.

children.title: Economic Act 2075: Infrastructure Scope Expansion
children.summary: Expanded infrastructure projects to include 'railway' in addition to existing categories.

children.title: Tax on Public Infrastructure/Hydropower (Dafa 2(4)) (Repealed)
children.summary: Repeal of 20% tax on public entities for public infrastructure (build-operate-transfer) and hydropower projects; repealed by Economic Act 2076.

children.title: Tax on Estates and Trusts (Dafa 2(5))
children.summary: Amendment to tax treatment of taxable income for deceased resident's estate or non-resident natural person's trust.

children.title: Tax on Non-Resident Income (Dafa 2(7))
children.summary: Amendments to tax rates for non-resident's taxable income related to Dafa 70, with specific rates for transport/telecom services.

nodes.title: Schedule-2: Depreciation Provisions
nodes.summary: Amendments to additional depreciation rates and specific deductions for energy production assets.

children.title: Additional Depreciation Rates (Dafa 1(2))
children.summary: Additional 1/3 depreciation deduction for specific projects under Dafa 19(2) and entities under Schedule-1, Dafa 2(3) and (4); amended by Economic Act 2077.

children.title: Depreciation for Energy Production Assets (Dafa 1(3))
children.summary: Evolution of 50% depreciation deduction for capital assets used to produce energy for own use.

children.title: Original Deduction for Manufacturing Industries
children.summary: 50% depreciation for manufacturing industries' capital assets used for own energy production; added by Economic Act 2067.

children.title: Economic Act 2072 Revisions
children.summary: 50% depreciation for any person's capital assets used for own business energy production.
